title: Rapidity
summary: RAPID'ITY, noun [Latin rapiditas.] 1. Swiftness; celerity; velocity; as the rapidity of a current; the rapidity of motion of any kind. 2. Haste in utterance; as the rapidity of speech or pronunciation

inlines.v: RAPID'ITY, noun [Latin rapiditas.] 1. Swiftness; celerity; velocity; as the rapidity of a current; the rapidity of motion of any kind. 2. Haste in utterance; as the rapidity of speech or pronunciation. 3. Quickness of progression or advance; as rapidity of growth or improvement.
